build.normalization: Build/source prefixes map to /usr/src/dotnet-ios-linux/binutils-2.47, build IDs are disabled, and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is fixed. Two builds from distinct source, build, destination, and Swift prefixes produced identical staged tools.

xtool.status: hermetic logical-path and pinned-normalizer build verified twice in project-owned Linux x86-64 stages
xtool.resolutionCorrection: Swift 6.4 resolves OpenCombine 0.14.0 transitively; it is absent from the upstream 54-pin file and is included in the enforced project lock.

stagedOutputs.normalization: A rootless user/mount namespace overlays the installer-created neutral /tmp/dotnet-ios-linux mountpoint with private tmpfs, then exposes each distinct physical scratch tree at one fixed logical child path before Swift compilation. No OpenCode path or pre-existing host child directory is required. Hash-locked GNU Binutils 2.47 removes the varying build-ID note, zeroes .swift_modhash, and strips unneeded symbols. Two clean offline builds from distinct physical build and Swift prefixes produced byte-identical final xtool and XADI files.
stagedOutputs.localEvidence: Final ELF metadata and complete bytes matched, neither physical build/Swift prefix nor the superseded OpenCode path was present, and the staged executable reported the exact revision. Runtime and dynamic-loader checks ran only after candidate agreement and passed with LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset. The earlier staged LLVM normalizer was rejected because it changed XADI and retained cross-prefix xtool differences.

reproducibilityIncident.cause: Swift #file literals retained distinct physical SwiftPM scratch paths in 59 .rodata bytes; debug/file prefix maps do not rewrite those runtime strings.
reproducibilityIncident.disposition: The original historical hash was replaced only after two clean fixed-logical-path offline builds produced identical complete files. The first hermetic output was subsequently superseded after its OpenCode-specific logical parent was identified as non-portable; two more clean offline builds qualified the neutral namespace-private path. The full hash gate remained enabled throughout.
